title: Saronic hero
description: A window-tall hero over full-bleed footage under a slate wash. Desktop spreads a giant stretched wordmark across the top and sets a mono eyebrow, a three-line 450-weight headline and two buttons (lime + translucent) in a column from 60% of the width; phones put the copy at the bottom. The copy rises in on load; while the hero scrolls away the footage stays pinned and dims to 20% and the wordmark and copy fade out.
notes: always dark (it carries the `dark` class): light text over footage in either mode
media fills the whole hero; empty it is a muted placeholder
use `belowBar` when saronic-announcement sits above it, and saronic-header with `overlay` so the bar floats over it
CSS only: load rise and the scroll-driven pin/fade are off under reduced motion; without scroll-timeline support everything stays in place
